decisive_items: High-arched palate, elongated face with dolichocephaly
Giant motor unit potential and neuropathic changes in proximal and distal muscles
Long exercise test: 25% maximal decrement at 45 minutes post-exercise
response.rationale: Facial dysmorphism and neuropathic EMG with decrement favor myotonic dystrophy despite absent myotonia; congenital muscular dystrophy is less likely due to late progressive onset and no family history.

rejected.why: Duchenne muscular dystrophy is implausible in a female with only mild CK elevation and no family history.
Perinatal features and biopsy are suggestive, but the late progressive weakness and lack of family history are less consistent.
